verdict.rationale: Raygun's AI Resolution feature explicitly auto-prompts an LLM (OpenAI/Azure OpenAI, GPT-4) with 'crucial error context from your stack trace, environment, and affected code' to produce fast, accurate root-cause fixes, and lets teams collaboratively chat and act on the suggestion. This directly matches the AI-native root-cause-analysis story, though the evidence doesn't explicitly confirm breadcrumbs or related-commit data are fed into the AI prompt (only source-map/repo linking is documented separately) and there's no independent/hands-on corroboration of AI accuracy. missing for 10: explicit inclusion of breadcrumbs/commit data in AI context, independent verification of suggestion quality.
